verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents one cookbook showing tasks/workflows exposed as tools for Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK, which is a first-party-style integration point for agent workloads, but this is a single cookbook rather than a broad suite of official AI SDK/model-provider wrappers eliminating glue code across the stack. missing for 10: first-party wrappers for major model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) beyond agent-tool exposure, integrations with other agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.), and evidence of durability semantics baked into these wrappers rather than a manual cookbook pattern.
